explication: ONCE manages Docker-hosted web applications through an interactive TUI and CLI: users install an image, configure its hostname and settings, then monitor and operate it. The graph includes deployment, app lifecycle, backups/restores, scheduled updates, service management, and monitoring capabilities documented or visible in the supplied sources. Edges are limited to relationships evidenced by excerpts, the source index, or README; unsampled command and UI internals are represented only where documented.
